executive_readiness_summary.rule13_trigger_rationale: Observed 4 client-side automation/telemetry signal(s) on www.practo.com (including CRM, CDP, session replay, chat, or ad-tech integrations), which warrant formal documentation under Rule 13(1)-(2) DPIA and algorithmic governance workflows.
key_observed_strengths: HTTPS transport security active on https://www.practo.com/ (HTTP 200, 313ms response time).
Zero pre-ticked consent checkboxes observed across 0 inspected DOM form(s).
Surfaces 2 accessible privacy/legal notice link(s) directly in the DOM.
priority_readiness_enhancements: Consent & Dark-Pattern Symmetry (Sec 6 / Rules 3-4): Configure a DPDP-aligned Consent Management Platform (CMP) with equal visual prominence for Accept and Reject/Manage buttons, and set `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, and `SameSite=Lax/Strict` on all session cookies.

Website Automations, AI & Profiling (Sec 6 / Rule 13(2)): Maintain an internal Website Automation & Tag Governance Register mapping each client-side SDK to its consent category, data retention TTL, and DOM input-masking configuration.

Grievance Redressal & 90-Day SLA (Sec 13 / Rule 14(3)): Add a dedicated Grievance Redressal & DPO section to the Privacy Notice footer specifying the Officer name/designation, email/portal link, and the Rule 14(3) 90-day maximum resolution SLA.

Cross-Border Sub-Processors (Sec 16 / Rule 15): Maintain a live Sub-Processor & Cross-Border Transfer Register covering all third-party script/CDN domains and verify valid Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) under Section 8(2).
executive_readiness_summary.board_advisory_synopsis: This confidential, read-only passive DPIA readiness assessment of Practo (Digital Healthcare & Clinic Platform) (https://www.practo.com, Sector: Healthcare & Clinics) evaluated publicly observable HTTP headers, 2 Set-Cookie header(s), 4 external script(s), and 4 client-side automation signature(s) against the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 846(E)). Overall Readiness Score: 76/100 (Moderate Readiness (Advisory Enhancements Recommended)).

advisory_findings.observed_technical_signal: HTTP 200 on https://www.practo.com; 2 privacy/legal notice link(s) detected in DOM (https://www.practo.com/company/privacy, https://www.practo.com/company/terms).
advisory_findings.statutory_mapping: DPDP Act, 2023 Section 5(1) read with DPDP Rules, 2025 Rule 3 (Itemised Notice in clear and plain language)
advisory_findings.reputation_safe_advisory_note: The website surfaces 2 accessible privacy/legal notice link(s) in the DOM. To strengthen Rule 3 readiness, ensure the notice presents an itemised inventory of personal data categories and specific processing purposes at every data collection point.
advisory_findings.recommended_engineering_fix: Ensure every page footer and data collection form includes a prominent, static HTML anchor link to an itemised Section 5 / Rule 3 Privacy Notice with multi-language support (Eighth Schedule languages).
advisory_findings.verification_method: Run a read-only curl/DOM check on the landing page and verify `<a href="/privacy">` is present in the server-rendered HTML.

advisory_findings.observed_technical_signal: Set-Cookie headers on initial GET: 2 cookie(s) (2 first-party, 0 third-party; cookie names: AKA_A2, ak_bmsc); CMP banners detected: none; pre-ticked checkboxes: 0.
advisory_findings.statutory_mapping: DPDP Act, 2023 Section 6(1) & Section 6(4) read with DPDP Rules, 2025 Rules 3 and 4 (Free, specific, informed, unconditional consent & withdrawal ease)
advisory_findings.reputation_safe_advisory_note: Initial page load sets 2 cookie(s) and loads 4 client-side telemetry/automation script signature(s) prior to an affirmative consent interaction. While common across modern web architectures, gating non-essential analytics and marketing tags behind an explicit opt-in banner with symmetrical 'Accept' and 'Reject / Manage' controls aligns the user journey with Section 6(1) and Section 6(4).
advisory_findings.recommended_engineering_fix: Configure a DPDP-aligned Consent Management Platform (CMP) with equal visual prominence for Accept and Reject/Manage buttons, and set `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, and `SameSite=Lax/Strict` on all session cookies.
advisory_findings.verification_method: Inspect initial HTTP `Set-Cookie` headers and network requests in a clean browser profile before interacting with the consent banner.

advisory_findings.observed_technical_signal: Detected 4 client-side automation signature(s) across 4 external script(s): Google Tag Manager (GTM) (DOM/Script signature match: googletagmanager.com/gtag/js); Google Analytics 4 (GA4) (DOM/Script signature match: google-analytics.com); AppsFlyer / Branch Attribution (DOM/Script signature match: appsflyer.com); Meta / Facebook Pixel (fbevents.js) (DOM/Script signature match: connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js).
advisory_findings.statutory_mapping: DPDP Act, 2023 Section 6 & Section 10(2)(c) read with DPDP Rules, 2025 Rule 13(1)-(3) (Annual DPIA & algorithmic/automated software risk assessment)
advisory_findings.reputation_safe_advisory_note: Passive DOM inspection identified 4 client-side automation or telemetry integration(s). Under Rule 13(2), Significant Data Fiduciaries (and privacy-forward enterprises conducting proactive DPIAs) are encouraged to document the purpose, behavioral profiling scope, and consent binding of all tag managers, CRM trackers, session replay tools, and conversational widgets.
advisory_findings.recommended_engineering_fix: Maintain an internal Website Automation & Tag Governance Register mapping each client-side SDK to its consent category, data retention TTL, and DOM input-masking configuration.
advisory_findings.verification_method: Verify that every script in the tag manager is bound to an explicit consent trigger and documented in the annual Rule 13 DPIA ledger.

advisory_findings.observed_technical_signal: Security headers on https://www.practo.com/: HSTS=Present, CSP=Present, X-Frame-Options=SAMEORIGIN, X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, Referrer-Policy=Absent.
advisory_findings.statutory_mapping: DPDP Act, 2023 Section 8(5) read with DPDP Rules, 2025 Rule 6 (Reasonable security safeguards, encryption in transit, access controls) and Rule 8(3) (1-year minimum security log retention)
advisory_findings.reputation_safe_advisory_note: All primary HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options) are present on www.practo.com, supporting robust transport and browser-side script isolation under Rule 6.
advisory_findings.recommended_engineering_fix: Configure edge CDN/web server responses to include Strict-Transport-Security (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains), a restrictive Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, alongside 1-year security log retention (Rule 8(3)).
advisory_findings.verification_method: Run `curl -sI https://www.practo.com` and confirm all recommended security headers are returned with HTTP 200.
